content: Dicloxacillin sodium, USP, is classified as an antibacterial agent belonging to the isoxazolyl penicillin series. It is a semisynthetic penicillin that is resistant to penicillinase and stable in acidic environments, making it suitable for oral administration. Chemically, dicloxacillin sodium is designated as 4-Thia-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptane-2-carboxylic acid, 6-[3-(2,6-dichlorophenyl)-5-methyl-4-isoxazolyl]-amino]-3,3-dimethyl-7-oxo-, monosodium salt, monohydrate. Its structural formula is provided in the original description. Each capsule intended for oral use contains dicloxacillin sodium in amounts equivalent to either 250 mg or 500 mg of dicloxacillin. The inactive ingredient in the formulation is magnesium stearate. The capsule shells are composed of FD&C Blue 1, titanium dioxide, and gelatin.
